notes.title: HelmetFire is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Hello gamers,[/p][p][/p][p]HelmetFire is now available! [/p][p][/p][p]Day 1 patch has been released. Fixed some bugs including:[/p][p]-Collision issues[/p][p]-Gochim duplication issue[/p][p]-incorrect gambling pricing[/p][p]-Added redundancy to negative scoring[/p][p]-Balanced some scoring modifiers extensively[/p][p][/p][p]Apologies to anyone who got a dev key that doesn't work. Issue has been resolved.[/p][p][/p][p]Please share any and all feedback you have. It helps me a lot. [/p][p][/p][p]Competitive season roadmap is here and in the discord. [/p][p][/p][p]More balance tweaks will be coming soon as I collect more feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support![/p]
